learner_operation: Classify the displayed number by mathematical value, after at most one elementary fraction/root simplification, then determine every containing set in N subset Z subset Q subset R subset C; N excludes zero.

fixed_features.feature: Five basic containing sets and their definitions
fixed_features.justification: Introduction tutorial 2d61ed1f-938f-51f3-8f72-19f2a9db35ea defines the sets and excludes zero from N; all supplied questions classify one given value.
All real and nonreal numbers in the lesson are complex. Necessary mathematical inclusion; no source assignment permits excluding C.

fixed_features.feature: One number and elementary simplification, easy difficulty
fixed_features.justification: Canonical 3.25 and source -27/3, sqrt(121), sqrt(-2) establish recognition or one short simplification.

fixed_features.feature: Ordinary generation uses five checkbox fields; radio banks archival
fixed_features.justification: Five Boolean choices directly express the original select-all contract. Previously reviewed presentation remains; all three complete source radio banks are now faithfully replayed. No random radio-family coverage claim.

answer_roles.role: Smallest containing set and consequent selection count
answer_roles.eligible_variation: N, Z, Q, R or C may be the smallest containing set. Assignments derive from the value, never bank position or label arrangement.
answer_roles.observed: All five masks survive in fresh delivered sample. Exact delivered batch contains N twice, R once, C once; no tested complete-answer positional or label-mask cue solves the batch.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Integers may be positive/nonpositive; fractions and decimals integral/nonintegral; radicals zero, positive square/nonsquare or negative. Negative radicands need not have square magnitude.
answer_roles.observed: 144/144 changed negative values construct and sample correctly; visible coefficients squared independently. Fresh multi-family regression and controlled roots show relevant class changes. Pi/negative roots have necessary fixed classifications.

answer_roles.role: Field order and complete radio choice identity
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Checkbox order may change independently of value. Archival radio key follows complete containing-set list instead of longest option or fixed index.
answer_roles.observed: Exhausted 31 fixed positional subsets across each raw/delivered set; none solves a set. Source-index replay and reordered source traversal preserve complete banks, keys and solutions.

coverage.result: All -144..-1 supported in construction and forced sampler; exact visible imaginary coefficient witnesses pass; ordinary fresh sample also exercises negative nonsquares.

coverage.case: all source radio banks and inferred legacy gap
